Genuine mudlark with 2 wins and a placing from 4 starts on heavy tracks. Carries only 55.0kg on the minimum and enters off a very tidy 4th beaten 1.5 lengths in BM66 grade at Bathurst. Live longshot threat.

Arrives at peak physical fitness third-up after an excellent 2nd beaten a long-neck at Gunnedah in Class 3 company. Handles soft surfaces well and has the tactical versatility to sit handy in canonical P style.

Ran on strongly from midfield to grab 3rd in Class 3 company at Gunnedah last start. Proven at the 1200m-1300m range with solid benchmark capability. Can run into exotic placings in canonical S style.

Experienced campaigner who ran a strong 2nd in BM58 grade at Bathurst on a heavy track last start. Carries 60.0kg effective weight tax which caps winning upside, but remains honest for minor multiples in canonical P style.
